0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 2nd in the Northwest, on a 4-1 run over their last five) visit the Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and the West, on a five-game winning streak) as the Thunder's sixth game of the season, with the Thunder 1-1 on the road. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is without Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 2-1, and Houston beat Oklahoma City 112-106 in their last meeting, on February 7, 2026, in Oklahoma City.
